candidates.requirement: Every gzFile that the harness opens must be released before it drops the handle.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput -> gzopen(mode "w") -> case 21 gzclose_r(file); file = NULL -> gzclose(NULL)
candidates.failure_condition: Input 02 77 15 opens the file with mode "w" (write). Op 1 is 'w'%26=15 (gzdirect). Op 2 is 0x15=21, which calls gzclose_r on the write handle. gzclose_r returns Z_STREAM_ERROR without freeing the state or closing the fd. The harness then sets file=NULL, so the final gzclose(NULL) frees nothing. The heap state and the fd leak on every such input.
candidates.alternative_paths: None. After the handle is nulled, the harness keeps no other reference, and gzclose(NULL) returns early.
